## Commit order

The step boundaries in §4 **are** the commit boundaries. That is what keeps a ~60-file PR
reviewable: eighteen scoped commits are navigable, three are not. Order matters more than it did
under §2 because there is no merge between stages.

| # | Commit | From §4 step |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `chore(ci): SFCC-11 add cart e2e area to qa.yml` | 0 |
| 2 | `feat(icons): SFCC-271 port PlusIcon to zimm.tsx` | §10 (1) |
| 3 | `fix(drawer): SFCC-315 correct ZimmDrawer xLarge width` | 1.1 |
| 4 | `chore(cart): SFCC-270 copy-first product-item + item-variant` | 2.1 — **STOP** |
| 5 | `feat(cart): SFCC-270 restyle override, fix item-name spread order` | 2.2 |
| 6 | `feat(cart): SFCC-315 ZimmCartDrawer organism` | 1.2 |
| 7 | `feat(cart): SFCC-271 ZimmQuantityStepper` | 3.1 |
| 8 | `feat(cart): SFCC-795 ZimmInlineMessage, error and warning states` | 3.2 |
| 9 | `feat(cart): SFCC-795 promotional price and discount label` | 3.3 |
| 10 | `feat(cart): SFCC-250 cartItemMapper and maxOrderQuantity util` | 3.4 |
| 11 | `feat(cart): SFCC-271-250 wire ZimmQuantityStepper and maxOrderQuantity into product-item` | 3.5 (inserted 2026-09-18) |
| 12 | `fix(a11y): SFCC-795 accessibility sweep` | 3.6 (renumbered from 3.5) |
| 13 | `feat(auth): SFCC-250 passwordless basket merge` | 4.1 |
| 14 | `feat(cart): SFCC-250 useCartMergeAndCap` | 4.2 |
| 15 | `feat(cart): SFCC-272 useCartMessages` | 4.3 |
| 16 | `feat(cart): SFCC-272 ZimmCartItemActions and pending-item resume` | 4.4 |
| 17 | `feat(cart): SFCC-272 ZimmCartEmptyState` | 4.5 |
| 18 | `feat(cart): SFCC-275 ZimmCartButtonGroup and Pay marks` | 5.1 |
| 19 | `feat(cart): SFCC-315 wire the drawer trigger in _app and product-view` | §9 |

`commit-msg` enforces conventional format and `/generate-changelog` depends on it, so every message
is `type(scope): SFCC-NNN description`.

**Two things this ordering buys:**

- **Commit 18 puts the trigger last.** Under §2 it had to ship with B1. Here nothing is reachable
  until everything is built, and the review reads as "here is the thing, here is where we plug it
  in." A genuine gain from the single-PR shape.
- **Commit 4 preserves the copy-first pause intact.** Copy-first was never about branching — it is
  about not bundling the override copy with functional change. Commit 4 stops and waits for
  Marcel to observe all eight markers from the cart, the account wishlist page and a checkout
  summary. Nothing proceeds until that is recorded.

## Loop, restated per commit group

§5's per-step Tester/Scorer criteria stand verbatim. Only the per-branch scaling is replaced:

| Commits | Loop |
|---|---|
| 1 | None. Verified by reading `detect-changes`'s output on the next cart PR. |
| 2, 3 | Light — a path check and a width assertion. |
| 4 | **Mandatory human stop.** The one step a machine cannot score alone. |
| 5–11 | Full loop. Largest surface: ~25 ACs including 11 accessibility. |
| 12–16 | Full loop, and **commit 13 gets the only adversarial pass** — concurrency, double-write, server rejection, boundary at 2/3/4/5, and proving `useIsMutating()` by making it fail on purpose first. |

## Step 4.1 — `feat(auth): SFCC-250 passwordless basket merge` (commit 13 of 19)

Read `plan.md`'s Step 4.1 text, its `## 5.0 Verification standard`, the commit-order table, and the loop-configuration tables myself (found at `~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-11/plan.md` — not under the repo's own `.runs/`, which doesn't exist). Confirmed via `git status --porcelain` that exactly the two named files are dirty. Read both full diffs and the complete current `useWishlistAuthDrawer.ts`.

| Axis | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Completeness** | PASS (disclosed gap) | All 6 of step 4.1's own pass criteria met with evidence (below). The mutation has no `onError`/`onSuccess`/`isPending` surfaced — real, but not a criterion this step wrote for itself, and pass criterion 6 already licenses deferring live-failure-mode verification. Treated as an accepted, disclosed gap, not a Completeness failure — see residual risk. |
| **Correctness** | PASS | `tsc --noEmit` clean (ran myself, whole project). `useWishlistAuthDrawer.test.tsx` 18/18 green (ran myself). Lint on the test file: zero problems (ran myself — confirms the prettier fix). Lint on the `.ts` file: 1 error + 2 warnings, but I diffed against `git show HEAD` and confirmed **byte-for-byte the same 3 problems exist in the pre-diff baseline**, at shifted line numbers only — 100% pre-existing (`formatMessage` destructure, unrelated to this work), zero new lint issues introduced. Not this step's defect; noted for awareness only. No 🔴 Tester findings. |
| **Restraint** | PASS | Orchestrator: IN SCOPE, exactly the 2 authorized files (independently confirmed via my own `git status`). Effort: the commit-group loop table's "commit 13 gets the only adversarial pass — concurrency, double-write, boundary at 2/3/4/5, `useIsMutating()`" is a **plan-internal mislabel**, not evidence of Tester over-run — see "What Marcel is missing." None of that content applies to this diff (no boundary logic, no `useIsMutating` anywhere in scope here — that's 4.2's `useCartMergeAndCap`, confirmed by reading 4.2's actual text). The Tester's double-sub-fork mutation runs are explainable by that same misleading line, not gratuitous. |
| **Design fidelity** | PASS (not triggered — see reasoning) | Independently confirmed zero JSX, zero `.scss`/`.css.ts`, zero theme/recipe, zero Chakra props anywhere in either file — this is a hook-internals change plus its own test. **No Marcel visual checkpoint is owed.** Reasoning: the axis exists to catch a rendered result silently diverging from Figma — there is no render in this diff to diverge. I also traced the actual call ordering: `onClose()`/`setIsOtpAuthOpen(false)`/`onAuthSuccess?.()` still fire synchronously, unchanged, *before* the new `mergeBasket.mutate()` line — so there's no new timing-based visual effect hiding in here either. Marking this UNVERIFIED (as opposed to N/A) would wrongly imply outstanding visual work is owed; there is none. |
| **Conformance** | PASS | TS-only, both files `.ts`/`.tsx`. `useShopperBasketsV2Mutation` confirmed real (grepped `node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` and `commerce-sdk-isomorphic`'s own `.d.ts`: `mergeBasketQueryParameters` really has `createDestinationBasket?: boolean` and `productItemMergeMode?: "higher_quantity"\|"sum_quantities"\|"saved_quantity"\|"separate_item"` — both params used are real and correctly typed, not hallucinated). No Tier 1/2 file touched. No refactor-upward, no rename, no signature change. |
| **Pass criteria** | PASS | All 6 checked with my own evidence, not just relayed: (1) merge-args assertion — mutation-tested by me directly (see below), passes for real; (2) create-account non-call — traced structurally (`onCreateAccount`→`handleDrawerClose`→`onClose()` sets `isOpen` false before `isRegistered` can flip, so the merge effect's own guard can't be satisfied) and test passes; (3) social-IDP untouched — confirmed it's a separate, undiffed effect, test passes; (4) 4-consumer regression — grepped all four test files myself: `drawer-menu`, `product-view`, `header/rightBar` all `vi.mock` the whole `ZimmWishlistAuthDrawer` component (never exercise the real hook), exactly as disclosed — Orchestrator's very recent 83-test run stands, not re-run by me (unchanged diff); (5) exported `UseWishlistAuthDrawerReturn` — read it directly, byte-identical to `git show HEAD`; (6) PR-body live-verification disclaimer — not yet checkable, no PR exists for a mid-bundle commit. |

## Overall: PASS

## What I tried to falsify

1. **Mutation-tested pass criterion 1 myself, independently of the Tester's own sub-forks.** Backed up the working file, changed `productItemMergeMode: 'sum_quantities'` → `'higher_quantity'` at the real call site, reran the test file: exactly 1 of 18 failed, with the exact expected diff (`sum_quantities` → `higher_quantity`) in the assertion error. Restored the file from backup, confirmed byte-identical via `md5` , reran: 18/18 green again. This is real, not relayed — the test is genuinely sensitive to the value it claims to check.
2. **Tried to find a lint regression the diff introduced.** Stashed the two files, linted the pre-diff baseline, found the identical 1 error + 2 warnings already present at (unshifted) line numbers. Diff introduces **zero new lint problems** — the one real issue on this file predates SFCC-11 entirely.
3. **Tried to disprove "base parity" as an excuse for the missing error handling.** Read the actual shipped `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-auth-modal.js`. Confirmed base's own `handleMergeBasket` wraps `.mutate()` in a try/catch that cannot catch anything (`.mutate()` doesn't throw asynchronously) — so base's own shipped code has the identical silent-failure shape, not a stronger one this diff is falling short of.
4. **Tried to find the "commit 13 adversarial pass" content actually applying here.** Read step 4.2's text directly — boundary-at-2/3/4/5 and `useIsMutating()` are 100% 4.2's `useCartMergeAndCap` concerns; nothing in 4.1's actual diff has quantity thresholds or a render-guard to race. Confirmed the commit-group table's line is a mislabel, not a second requirement this diff silently skipped.
5. **Tried to find scope creep or an untested regression path** the 4-consumer claim might be hiding — grepped each consumer test file's own mocks directly rather than trusting the characterization; confirmed all three genuinely mock the drawer wholesale (so "still green" really does mean only "mocked surface unchanged," exactly as disclosed, not an overstated regression claim).

All five held. Nothing above changed the verdict.

## What I could not verify

- **The full 1353-test suite and the 83-test consumer/hook run** — relied on the Tester's and Orchestrator's very recent runs rather than re-running myself, since nothing has changed in the diff since either ran. If either is doubted, it needs re-running, not me tripling it for no new information.
- **The re-open race** (`handleTriggerClick`'s `customer?.isRegistered` vs. the merge effect's own `isRegistered` transiently disagreeing) — Tester attempted 3 reproductions and failed; I did not attempt a 4th (proportionality). Stays PLAUSIBLE, not CONFIRMED-absent.
- **Runtime `siteId`/`locale` injection into the `mergeBasket` call** — neither base's call nor this one passes them explicitly; I confirmed the SDK's query-parameter type marks them required-but-satisfiable-by-context, and that base's shipped call has the identical omission, but I did not trace `CommerceApiProvider`'s actual injection mechanism end-to-end.
- **Pass criterion 6's PR-body disclaimer and criterion 4's PR-body blast-radius naming** — can't exist yet; this is commit 13 of 19 on a branch, not an open PR. Needs checking when the bundle PR is actually opened.

## Defects / notes (none blocking; none require a REWORK round)

- `overrides/app/hooks/useWishlistAuthDrawer.ts:200-210` (the `mergeBasket.mutate({...})` call) — **PLAUSIBLE, disclosed, not blocking.** No `onError`/`isPending` handling; a failed merge fails exactly as silently as base's own does. Documented below as the residual risk, not scored as a defect, because no pass criterion for this step asked for it and base ships the same shape.
- `overrides/app/hooks/useWishlistAuthDrawer.ts:116` (pre-diff baseline, unrelated to this commit) — **CONFIRMED, out of scope.** `formatMessage` destructure trips `@typescript-eslint/unbound-method`; pre-existing on `HEAD`, unrelated to SFCC-250. Worth a separate, unrelated cleanup ticket — not this step's problem, not requiring rework here.
- `~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-11/plan.md:962` — **CONFIRMED, plan document defect, not a code defect.** "commit 13 gets the only adversarial pass" contradicts §5.0's own table (line 509), which assigns the adversarial pass to step 4.2 by name ("the only step that gets one") — and commit 13 = step 4.1 per the commit-order table at line 931, commit 14 = step 4.2 at line 932. The adversarial content described (boundary 2/3/4/5, `useIsMutating`) is unambiguously 4.2's. Worth a one-line fix (`13` → `14`) before this section is read again for commit 14's own scoring, so the actual adversarial-pass budget lands on the step that needs it.

## Biggest residual risk in shipping this step

If the `mergeBasket` API call itself fails (network/server error), nothing surfaces it — `onClose`/`onAuthSuccess` already fired above it, so the shopper sees a normal successful sign-in with a still-orphaned guest basket, and no later step in this bundle owns catching that (4.2's own error-handling pass criteria are scoped to the quantity-cap write, not this merge). This is a quieter recurrence of the exact defect SFCC-250 exists to close. Matches base SFCC's own shipped behavior, so it isn't a regression this diff introduces — but it's real, live-only (can't be repro'd in this test harness), and currently unowned by name in the remaining plan. Recommend a one-line follow-up (PR-body note or a fast-follow ticket) before the SFCC-11 bundle PR ships, rather than letting it fall through the gap between 4.1 and 4.2's separately-scoped error handling.

## What Marcel is missing

Not about this diff: `plan.md`'s commit-group loop table (line 962) currently tells whoever scores **commit 14** (`useCartMergeAndCap`, step 4.2 — the actual concurrency/double-write/boundary-value/`useIsMutating` step) that the adversarial pass belongs to "commit 13" instead. If that line is read literally when 4.2 comes up, the step that most needs the adversarial treatment could get scored as if it already happened three commits early, on a diff that has no boundary logic at all. Fix is a one-character line-number correction, but worth doing before commit 14 is dispatched, not after.
